gaps.valueSet: Two separate sputum specimens with qualifying Mycobacterium culture results
gaps.reason: the authoritative source explicitly marks source rule 2 inoperable because RCKMS cannot evaluate two separate specimens; SEM_V1 cannot compare or count distinct specimen observations, so the rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Sputum and lower-respiratory specimen constraints on generic culture and nucleic-acid tests
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no laboratory specimen-type evidence or predicate, and the source HL7 specimen value sets have no codes; unrestricted test branches requiring separate specimen linkage are omitted from NMIP-R3 through NMIP-R8 while specimen-specific test-name branches remain modeled
the authoritative source marks these reporter types unavailable in RCKMS; reporter-type routing and the death-certificate criterion are not represented in the condition pack
